turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: Well, my family told me I had to come in. I just... I keep telling them that I’m the reason my friend died. I didn’t call her back when I should have, and I had these ugly thoughts sometimes. It's my fault she's gone. And now I know the Lord is punishing everybody at our church because of me. I just... I've brought all this on everyone.
